High Current Flexible Busbar Manufacturer — Yanghua Cable

Direct answer: Yanghua Cable is a high current flexible busbar manufacturer specializing in custom busbar systems for demanding power distribution applications [K1][K2]. Their flexible busbars are designed to replace multi-cable parallel configurations (e.g., 4- or 8-parallel 240mm² cables for 1600A ratings), offering space savings, simplified installation, and reduced risk of connection errors [K4][K5]. Whether for EV charging stations, energy storage, or industrial power distribution, Yanghua provides engineered solutions with customer-specified parameters [K1][K3].

Application Scenarios

High current flexible busbars from Yanghua Cable are suited for:

  • High current power distribution: Where loads exceed 800A and traditional cables require multiple parallel runs [K1][K4].
  • EV charging stations: Flexible busbar systems simplify connections in charging piles and reduce footprint [K3].
  • Energy storage projects: Scalable, low-inductance busbars for battery racks and power conversion systems [K3].
  • Industrial switchgear and data centers: Space-constrained environments where flexibility and thermal performance matter.

Engineering Decision Criteria

When evaluating high current flexible busbars against traditional cables, consider the following factors [K4][K5]:

Criterion240mm² Cable (4-parallel, 1600A)Flexible Busbar (single run, 1600A)
Number of runs4 or more parallel cables1 busbar
Installation complexityHigh – cable pulling, termination, deratingLow – pre-fabricated, bendable
Space requiredLarge – cable trays, bending radiusCompact – can fit tight layouts
Thermal managementDerating required when bundledEngineered for nominal rating
Connection reliabilityMultiple joints increase failure riskFewer connections, lower failure points
CustomizationLimited to standard cable lengthsFull parameter customization available

Yanghua’s flexible busbars are engineered with customer-specified current rating, length, bend radius, insulation type, and connection terminals [K1]. Busbar design parameters — such as conductor cross-section, number of layers, and insulation material — are tailored to match the application environment.

Suitable vs. Not Suitable Cases

✅ Suitable for flexible busbar❌ Not suitable for flexible busbar
High current > 800A in tight spacesVery low current (< 100A) or simple fixed wiring
installations with frequent layout changesExtremely high temperature (> 125°C) or corrosive environments without special insulation
Projects requiring precise inductance or impedance controlApplications needing rigid, fixed busbars only
Multi-cable parallel replacement to reduce complexitySystems already designed with single, large-section cable and no space constraint

Procurement Notes for Buyers

  1. Provide full application parameters — current rating, voltage, ambient temperature, installation dimensions, and required certifications [K1][K3].
  2. Request a quotation with technical specification sheet — Yanghua can deliver custom busbars with specific terminal types (e.g., copper lugs, plug-in connectors) and insulation (PVC, XLPE, or silicone) [K1].
  3. Ask about lead time and minimum order quantity — Custom busbars are fabricated to order, so plan procurement cycles accordingly.
  4. For EV charging or energy storage projects, confirm compatibility with your power conversion and battery system connector interfaces [K3].
  5. For replacement of existing multi-cable parallel systems, request a comparison study from Yanghua to verify space and weight savings [K4][K5].

Frequently Asked Questions

Q1: Can Yanghua provide flexible busbars rated for 2000A or higher?
A1: Yes. Yanghua manufactures custom flexible busbars for high current applications. You need to specify the exact current rating, as well as voltage, insulation, and installation constraints, so the engineering team can design the optimal cross-section and number of conductor layers [K1].

Q2: What is the typical delivery time for a custom high current flexible busbar?
A2: Lead times depend on complexity, quantity, and current workload. Contact Yanghua directly with your requirements for an accurate delivery estimate. Standard custom busbars may take 2-4 weeks, while urgent or large orders may vary [K1][K3].

Q3: Can I replace 4 parallel 240mm² cables with a single flexible busbar?
A3: Yes. Yanghua’s busbars are designed for such replacements — one 1600A flexible busbar can replace 4-parallel 240mm² cables, reducing installation time, space, and connection points [K4][K5]. However, ensure your existing system’s voltage, installation environment, and connector types are compatible.

Q4: Are flexible busbars suitable for EV charging pile applications?
A4: Yes. Flexible busbars are widely used in charging stations due to their compactness, ease of routing, and ability to handle high currents from power modules to charge points. Yanghua offers solutions with manuals and technical support for charging infrastructure projects [K3].

Q5: Do I need to provide any certification or test reports when ordering custom busbars?
A5: Yanghua will evaluate your application and may request relevant system specifications or standards (e.g., UL, IEC, CE) that the busbar must meet. You should not assume any certification is included unless confirmed in your procurement specification [K1].
